name: King Of Stratgy
description: strategy game simulating ancient battles with five unit types and 10 historical armies, each with unique traits. It features 30 challenging levels where players set formations and watch the outcome.

about.title: Project Overview
items: A strategy game that simulates ancient battles using squares as units
Five categories of units with different offensive and defensive abilities.
Ten historical armies, each with a unique ability.
Offline battles focused on pre-battle planning.
Option to hold and deploy units during the fight.

about.title: My Role
items: Organized and structured the project to ensure scalability and smooth development.
Programmed the core systems and gameplay mechanics.
Designed levels with balanced progression and difficulty.
